about: DERIVED: do not edit. The :root tokens of src/template.html, copied by `npm run email:tokens` so the Worker's emails draw the page's colours and fonts (a Worker cannot read the template at run time). Test M17 fails when this file differs from the template.

tokens.--head: Poppins, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
tokens.--body: "Open Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
